oromo: Pirezedantiin Raashiyaa Vladimir Puutin daawwannaa seena qabeessa ta'e kan inni godhe, bakkawwan bara 1945 irraa jalqabee Jaappaan kan kiyya jettu ganda Kuril jedhamutti. Muummichi ministeeraa Jaappaan Sanae Takaichi, daawwannaa kana akka hin fudhatamneefi bakkichis biyya isaanii ta'uu ibsuun balaaleffataniiru. Gochi kun hariiroo dippilomaasii Raashiyaafi Jaappaan gidduu jiru kan waraana Yuukireen irratti hundaa'e caalaatti kan hammeesse ta'uu gabaasameera.

title: Singapore-flagged container ship crashes into riverbank in India
english: A cargo ship registered in Singapore ran aground along the Hooghly River in eastern India. The incident occurred after the vessel experienced mechanical issues with its steering system while en route to the port of Kolkata. Authorities are currently managing the situation following the accidental collision with the riverbank.
amharic: በሲንጋፖር የተመዘገበ የጭነት መርከብ በምስራቅ ህንድ በምትገኘው ሁግሊ ወንዝ ዳርቻ ላይ ተጋጭቷል። መርከቧ ወደ ኮልካታ ወደብ በመጓዝ ላይ እያለች በአቅጣጫ መቆጣጠሪያዋ ላይ በተፈጠረ ችግር ምክንያት አደጋው ሊደርስ ችሏል። ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት በወንዝ ዳርቻው ላይ የደረሰውን ግጭት ተከትሎ አስፈላጊውን እርምጃ እየወሰዱ ነው።
oromo: Markaan fe'umsaa kan Singaporitti galmaa'e tokko gara baha Indiyaatti laga Huughlii cinaatti cabee bu'e. Rakkoon kun kan mudate yeroo markattiin sun gara buufata Kolkaataatti imalaa jirtetti sirna harka-kaachisuu (steering) ishee irratti rakkoon muudatee dha. Abbootiin taayitaa erga markattiin sun cina lafa lagaatti guuftee booda haala jiru to'achaa jiru.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The U.S. government is facing criticism for imposing visa restrictions on TPLF leaders, with critics arguing that this move prioritizes political convenience over essential justice for victims of atrocities. The author contends that ignoring accountability for genocide undermines the potential for a lasting peace in Ethiopia. By targeting those who demand justice and adherence to peace agreements, the U.S. is accused of betraying its own values and neglecting the necessity of truth in post-conflict transitions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በህወሓት መሪዎች ላይ የቪዛ ማዕቀብ መጣሉ ትችት እየገጠመው ነው። ተቺዎች ይህ ውሳኔ ለተፈጸሙ ግፍ ሰለባዎች ትክክለኛ ፍትህ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ለፖለቲካዊ ምቾት ቅድሚያ የሚሰጥ ነው ይላሉ። ደራሲው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀልን ተጠያቂነት ችላ ማለት በኢትዮጵያ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር የሚያስችል እድልን ያዳክማል ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። አሜሪካ ፍትህን የሚጠይቁትን በመቅጣት የራሷን እሴቶች እንደከዳች እና ከግጭት በኋላ የሚመጣውን የሽግግር ሂደት አስፈላጊ እውነታ ችላ እንዳለች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Amerikaa hoggantoota TPLF irratti uggura viizaa kaa'uun isaa qeeqa jabaa hordofsiiseera. Qeeqtoonni akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun miidhaa raawwatameef haqaa dhugaa kennuu irra faayidaa siyaasaa dura dursa kenna. Barreessaan kun akka jedhutti, duguuginsa sanyii raawwatameef itti gaafatamummaa dhabamsiisuun nagaa waaraa Itoophiyaa keessatti fiduu hin danda'u. Amerikaan haqaa fi kabajaa waliigaltee nagaa gaafatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuun, duudhaalee ofii ishee akka gantee fi dhuga-ba'ii fi haqaa aadaa cehuumsa keessatti barbaachisu akka tuffatte ibsameera.

title: FIFA’s Infantino backed by six Arab federations including Qatar and Morocco
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has received a significant boost as six Arab football federations, including Qatar and Morocco, publicly declared their support for his leadership. This endorsement comes while Infantino faces calls to resign from major global confederations following a failed plan to secure private investment for FIFA. Despite this internal pressure ahead of next year's election, these key nations remain committed to his vision for developing the sport.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በኳታር እና ሞሮኮን ጨምሮ በስድስት የአረብ ሀገራት እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽኖች ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። ይህ ድጋፍ የተሰጠው ኢንፋንቲኖ ለፊፋ ውድድሮች የግል ኢንቨስትመንት ለማስገባት ያቀረቡት ሀሳብ በመክሸፉ ምክንያት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከባድ ተቃውሞ እየገጠማቸው ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ለሚቀጥለው ዓመት ምርጫ እየተዘጋጁ ያሉትን ፕሬዝዳንቱን እነዚህ አገራት በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ ያላቸውን እምነት በይፋ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin FIFA Jaanni Iinfaantiinoo biyyoota Arabaa ja'a, kanneen akka Kaataar fi Moroookoo dabalatee, deeggarsa isaanii argataniiru. Deeggarsi kun kan dhufe, Iinfaantiinoon sagantaa FIFA keessatti investimantii dhuunfaa galchuuf qaban erga fashaleen booda, qondaaltota kubbaa miillaa idil-addunyaa biraa irraa dhiibbaan cimaan isaan irratti ka'ee jirutti. Akkuma gara fuulduraatti filannoon geggeeffamuuf jiruun, biyyoonni kun hojiin isaanii fi gaggeessummaan isaanii kan itti fufu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Pro-Palestine activists smear red paint on Danish defence company
english: Pro-Palestine demonstrators defaced the offices of Terma, a Danish defense manufacturer, by covering the building in red paint. The protesters targeted the firm to voice their opposition to its alleged role in supplying weaponry used during the conflict in Gaza. This act of vandalism was intended as a protest against the company's military production ties.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ አክቲቪስቶች በዴንማርክ የጦር መሳሪያ አምራች ኩባንያ ተርማ (Terma) ላይ ቀይ ቀለም በመቀባት ተቃውሟቸውን አሳይተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ኩባንያው በጋዛ በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ጥቅም ላይ በሚውሉ የጦር መሳሪያዎች ትርፍ እያገኘ ነው በማለት ተችተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የኩባንያውን ወታደራዊ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ለመቃወም የተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Deeggartoonni Falasxiin biyya Deenmaark keessatti argamu dhaabbata meeshaa waraanaa oomishu kan Terma jedhamu irratti gubbee diimaa dibuun mormii isaanii ibsataniiru. Mormitootni kun, dhaabbatichi waraana Gaaza keessatti meeshaalee waraanaa fayyadaman irraa bu'aa argata jedhanii komatu. Gochi kun dhaabbatichi hojii waraanaatiin walqabatee raawwatu mormuuf kan raawwatame dha.

title: Bangladesh humble Australia with worst total in contest as Hasan takes 6-55
english: Bangladesh dominated the first day of their Test match against Australia in Darwin by bowling the hosts out for just 198 runs. Hasan Mahmud delivered a career-best performance, claiming six wickets to help restrict the Australians to their lowest-ever total against Bangladesh. By the end of the day, the visitors responded strongly, reaching 96-1 and trailing by only 102 runs.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በዳርዊን በተካሄደው የሙከራ ግጥሚያ የመጀመሪያ ቀን አውስትራሊያን በ198 ሩጫ ብቻ በመገደብ አስደናቂ ብቃት አሳይታለች። ሃሰን ማህሙድ ስድስት ውድ የሆኑ ዊኬቶችን በመውሰድ አውስትራሊያ ከባንግላዲሽ ጋር ካደረገችው ጨዋታዎች በታችኛው የውጤት መጠን እንዲያበቁ አድርጓል። ቀኑ ሲጠናቀቅ የባንግላዲሽ ተጫዋቾች 96 ሩጫ በማግኘት በአውስትራሊያ ላይ ጠንካራ ጫና ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Bangladesh guyyaa jalqabaa qormaata ishee Australia waliin Darwinitti taasisteen taphattoota Australia fiigicha 198 qofa irratti dhaabuu dandeesseetti. Hasan Mahmud wiciiketii ja'a fudhachuun qabxii isaa olaanaa galmeessiseera, kunis Australia qabxii hanga ammaatti Bangladesh waliin taphatte keessatti argatte keessaa isa gad-aanaa akka ta'u taasiseera. Guyyaan yeroo xumuramu, Bangladesh fiigicha 96 argachuun Australia irratti carraa gaarii qabdi.

title: Photos: Hope fades in Colombia as teams dig for earthquake survivors
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake has struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 265 deaths and thousands of injuries. Rescue teams are working tirelessly through debris in search of nearly 500 missing individuals, though expectations for finding survivors are decreasing as time passes. The government has declared a state of emergency and national mourning as citizens gather in temporary shelters for support.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተው የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 265 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ከ3,500 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አሁንም ከ500 በላይ የጠፉ ሰዎችን በፍርስራሽ ስር እየፈለጉ ቢሆንም፣ በህይወት የመገኘት ተስፋ እየቀነሰ መጥቷል። መንግስት በአገሪቱ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ማወጁን ተከትሎ፣ የተጎዱ ዜጎች ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎችን በመጠቀም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti lafti socho’uu isaa hordofee namoonni 265 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera, kuma sadii ol immoo miidhaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa namoomaa namoota 500 ol ta’an kan hin argamin bakka caccabaa keessatti barbaacha jiruus, abdii lubbuun argachuu hir’achaa dhufeera. Mootummaan biyyattii hatattamaa ta’ee fi gadda biyyoolessaa kan labse yoo ta’u, namoonni miidhaman qubannaa yeroo keessa jiraachaa jiru.

title: US diplomat calls Israeli settler siege of West Bank homes ‘act of terror’
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has condemned an ongoing blockade of Palestinian homes in the West Bank village of Qusra by Israeli settlers as an act of terror. The settlers have cut off essential supplies like water and electricity to three families, including one with American citizenship, in an attempt to force them from their land. Despite initial attempts by Israeli security forces to clear the area, the families remain trapped and are refusing to abandon their properties.
amharic: የአሜሪካ አምባሳደር ማይክ ሃክቢ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን ከበባ እንደ ሽብርተኝነት ድርጊት አውግዘዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ ውሃ እና ኤሌክትሪክን ጨምሮ መሰረታዊ አቅርቦቶችን በማቋረጥ ቤተሰቦቹን ከቀያቸው ለማፈናቀል እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ፤ ከነዚህ ቤተሰቦች መካከል የአሜሪካ ዜግነት ያላቸውም ይገኙበታል። የእስራኤል የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ሰፋሪዎቹን ለማስለቀቅ ሙከራ ቢያደርጉም፣ ቤተሰቦቹ ቤታቸውን ለመልቀቅ ፈቃደኛ ሳይሆኑ አሁንም በእግድ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Israa'elitti argaman Maayik Hakbii, qe'ee qonnaan bultoota Israa'el naannoo Qusraa ishee Qarqara Lixaatti maatiiwwan Falasxiin irratti gochaa jiran kan 'shororkeessummaa' ta'uu ibsanii jiru. Qonnaan bultoonni kunneen maatiiwwan sadii, kanneen keessaas lammiilee Ameerikaa jiran, bishaan, ibsaa fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo irraa kutuun lafa isaanii irraa ari'uuf yaalaa jiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa Israa'el qonnaan bultoota kana achi baasuuf yaalii taasisanillee, maatiiwwan kun iddoo isaanii gadhiisuu diduun ammas achuma keessatti hidhamanii jiru.

title: Pentagon tells Congress US killed 153 civilians in Yemen air strikes
english: A recent Pentagon report submitted to Congress reveals that US military operations in Yemen during 2025 resulted in 153 civilian deaths and 243 injuries. These airstrikes were launched following President Trump's order to target Houthi forces in response to their attacks on Red Sea shipping. The document specifically highlighted high-casualty incidents in Sanaa and Hodeidah, with some actions facing calls for war crime investigations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ለኮንግረስ ባቀረበው ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ ባለፈው ዓመት በየመን በተካሄዱ የአየር ጥቃቶች 153 ንጹሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውንና 243 መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ለሚደርሰው ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። ሪፖርቱ በሳንዓ እና በሁዳይዳ የተፈጸሙ ገዳይ ጥቃቶችን በዝርዝር የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ በአንዳንድ ክስተቶች ላይ የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Gabaasni Ministeera Ittisa Biyyaa Ameerikaa gara Koongiresiitti ergame akka mul'isutti, bara darbe Yemen keessatti haleellaa qilleensaa Ameerikaan gaggeessiteen namoonni nagaa 153 du'anii 243 ammoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame loltoonni Huutii markaboota galaana diimaa keessa jiran irratti haleellaa waan raawwataniif Pirezidaant Traamp ajaja kennanii dha. Gabaasichi magaalaalee Sanaa fi Hodeidaa keessatti haleellaa ga'e ibsuudhaan, gochoota tokko tokko irratti qorannoon yakka waraanaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafatameera.

title: Gaza death toll reaches 73,389
english: The Palestinian health ministry reports that recent Israeli strikes in the Gaza Strip have resulted in at least one death and seven injuries. This latest violence adds to the ongoing conflict that began in October 2023. Current records indicate that the total number of Palestinians killed has now climbed to over 73,000, with more than 174,000 people wounded.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጤና ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው በእስራኤል በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተፈጸመ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሰባት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ከጥቅምት 2016 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ግጭት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው። አሁን ባለው መረጃ መሰረት በጋዛ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ73,000 በላይ የደረሰ ሲሆን ከ174,000 በላይ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Filisxeem akka gabaasetti, haleellaa Israa'el daangaa Gaazaa keessatti raawwatte kanaan namni tokko yoo du'u, torban immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun waraana Adoolessa 2023 jalqabee itti fufe keessatti kan dabalameedha. Akka ragaa amma jiruutti, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii 73,000 kan caale yoo ta'u, namoonni 174,000 ol ta'an immoo miidhaan irra ga'eera.

title: Mecca Defence Agreement will include political and military coordination, Turkey says
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have established a new defense agreement that focuses on closer political and military collaboration. This partnership involves high-level meetings between the nations' defense and foreign officials alongside their military leaders. The alliance aims to organize joint military drills and foster cooperation in defense manufacturing and technological development.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በፖለቲካ እና በወታደራዊ ዘርፍ የጠበቀ ትብብር ለማድረግ የሚያስችል አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ የሦስቱን ሀገራት የመከላከያና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች እንዲሁም የጦር አዛዦች ያካተተ የምክክር መድረክ ይፈጥራል። አጋርነቱ በጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን ለማከናወን እና በመከላከያ ኢንዱስትሪና ቴክኖሎጂ ሽግግር ላይ በጋራ ለመስራት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Turkey, Saudi Arabia fi Pakistan waligaltee ittisaa haaraa kan siyaasaa fi waraanaan walitti dhiyeenya uumu mallatteessaniiru. Waligalteen kun ministiroota ittisaa, ministiroota dhimma alaa fi qondaaltota waraanaa biyyoota sadanii walitti fiduun kan qophaaye dha. Tumsi kun leenjii waraanaa waliinii gaggeessuu fi oomisha meeshaalee waraanaa akkasumas guddina teeknooloojii irratti walta'iinsaan hojjechuuf kan karoorfate dha.

title: Salvage operation for stricken tanker off Omani coast begins
english: A salvage operation is underway to stabilize the Caroline Bezengi, a Cameroon-flagged tanker that has been stranded off the coast of Oman since early June following an unexplained explosion. Environmental authorities have confirmed that oil from the vessel has already polluted approximately 40 kilometers of the Omani shoreline. Western officials believe the ship is involved in transporting sanctioned Russian oil, raising concerns about a potential large-scale environmental disaster.
amharic: ሰኔ መጀመሪያ ላይ ያልታወቀ ፍንዳታ የገጠማት የካሜሮን ባንዲራ የምታውለበልበው የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ በመቆሟ የነፍረ-አድን ስራ እየተከናወነ ይገኛል። የኦማን የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት ከመርከቧ የፈሰሰው ነዳጅ ወደ 40 ኪሎ ሜትር የሚጠጋውን የባህር ጠረፍ መበከሉን አረጋግጠዋል። ምዕራባውያን መንግስታት መርከቧ የሩሲያን ማዕቀብ የተጣለበትን ነዳጅ ለማጓጓዝ የምትጠቀምበት የጥላ መርከቦች ቡድን አካል እንደሆነች በመግለጽ፣ ሁኔታው መጠነ ሰፊ የአካባቢ ጥፋት ሊያስከትል እንደሚችል ስጋት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Markabii gosa 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamu kan alaabaa Kaameruun qabateefi ji'a Waxabajjii keessa balaa dhohiinsaatiin ganda Omaanitti dhaabbate tasgabbeessuuf hojiin fayyinsaa eegalameera. Abbootiin taayitaa naannichaa akka mirkaneessanitti, dhangala'aan boba'aa markabicha keessaa ba'e qarqara galaana Omaan hamma kiilomeetira 40 ta'u faaleera. Mootummoonni lixaa markabni kun boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti tateen jiru guuruuf kan gargaaramaniifi garee 'shadow fleet' jedhamu keessaa akka ta'e dubbatanis, balaa naannoo guddaa qaqqabsiisuu danda'a jedhanii yaaddoo qabu.

title: Maersk CEO says conditions right to increase transit through Suez
english: Maersk's CEO expects the shipping giant to resume full transit through the Suez Canal by 2026, provided that security in Yemen remains stable. While the company recently reported strong financial results, it continues to monitor regional threats posed by Houthi attacks in the Red Sea. Along with partner Hapag-Lloyd, Maersk will gradually evaluate safety before finalizing its return to this critical trade route.
amharic: የማርስክ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ በየመን ያለው የፀጥታ ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ ከሆነ ኩባንያው እ.ኤ.አ በ2026 ሙሉ በሙሉ በስዊዝ ቦይ በኩል መጓጓዣውን ለመቀጠል እንዳቀደ ገልጸዋል። ኩባንያው ጠንካራ የገቢ ውጤቶችን እያስመዘገበ ቢሆንም በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚደርሱትን ጥቃቶች በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል። ከባልደረባዋ ሀፓግ-ሎይድ ጋር በመሆን ለደህንነት ሲባል የጉዞ መስመሩን ሁኔታ በጥንቃቄ እየገመገሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan olaanaa dhaabbata Maersk akka ibsetti, yoo haalli nageenyaa Yamanitti tasgabbaa’e, dhaabbatichi bara 2026 irraa eegalee daandii bishaan Suez guutumaan guutuutti fayyadamuu akka jalqabu abdii qaba. Dhaabbatichi bu’aa kaffaltii cimaa galmeessisus, haleellaa garee Huutii kan Galaana Diimaa keessatti raawwatamu hordofaa jira. Maersk dhaabbata Hapag-Lloyd wajjin ta’uun, nageenya qorachuun daandii daldalaa kanaatti deebi’uuf qophii taasisaa jira.

title: National Bank Forces Anbesa Bank Board Re-run, All Incumbents Out
english: The National Bank of Ethiopia mandated a new board election for Anbesa Bank after rejecting the previous results due to internal conflicts that threatened the institution's stability. During a supervised assembly held on August 8, 2026, shareholders voted for an entirely new group of 11 directors, removing all members of the former board. This leadership overhaul is intended to resolve long-standing disputes and ensure better governance for the bank and its depositors.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ብሄራዊ ባንክ በአንበሳ ባንክ የቀድሞ የቦርድ ምርጫ ላይ አለመግባባቶች በመፈጠሩ እና የባንኩን ደህንነት ስጋት ላይ በመጣሉ ምርጫው እንዲደገም አዟል። በዚህም መሰረት ነሐሴ 8 ቀን 2026 በተካሄደው ስብሰባ ባለአክሲዮኖች 11 አዳዲስ የቦርድ አባላትን በመምረጥ የነበሩትን ሙሉ በሙሉ አንስተዋል። ይህ አዲስ አመራር የባንኩን የአስተዳደር ችግሮች ለመፍታት እና ለተቀማጮች መረጋጋት ለማምጣት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Baankiin Biyyaalessaa Itoophiyaa, walitti buiinsa keessoo baankichaaf sodaachisaa ta'e hordofee, filannoon boordii Baankii Anbasaa duraanii akka haquufi irra deebi'amee akka gaggeeffamu ajaje. Fulbaana 8, 2026 walgahii addaa gaggeeffameen, qooda fudhattoonni miseensota boordii 11 haaraa filachuun miseensota boordii duraanii hunda bakka buusaniiru. Jijjiiramni gaggeessummaa kun rakkoolee bulchiinsa baankichaa furuufi nageenya qusattootaa eeguuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: The Storm Passed, the Freight Bill Did Not
english: A Bishoftu-based flower farm, Vegpro, has successfully recovered from a devastating storm that destroyed its greenhouses last year. However, the business is now facing a new crisis due to significant spikes in global shipping and transportation costs caused by regional instability. These rising freight prices are severely straining the company's thin profit margins, as it struggles to remain competitive in the European flower market.
amharic: ቢሾፍቱ የሚገኘው ቬግፕሮ የተባለ የአበባ እርሻ ከአንድ ዓመት በፊት በደረሰው አውሎ ንፋስ የደረሰበትን ጉዳት አስተካክሎ ወደ ስራ ቢመለስም አሁን ደግሞ በዓለም አቀፍ የጭነት ማጓጓዣ ዋጋ መናር ምክንያት ሌላ ፈተና ገጥሞታል። በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ባለው አለመረጋጋት የተነሳ የትራንስፖርት ወጪዎች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመራቸው የኩባንያውን ትርፍ በእጅጉ እየጎዳው ይገኛል። አነስተኛ የትርፍ ህዳግ ባለው የአበባ ገበያ ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀሰው ይህ ድርጅት፣ አሁን ካለው የዋጋ ጭማሪ ጋር ተያይዞ በአውሮፓ ገበያ ተወዳዳሪ ሆኖ ለመቀጠል እየተቸገረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qonnaan beeytii abaaboo Bishoftuutti argamtu kan Vegpro jedhamtu, ganna darbe bubbeen maasii ishee irratti miidhaa erraan gahee booda deebitee haala gaariin ijaarramtee jirti. Haa ta'u malee, yeroo ammaa kana rakkoon geejjibaa fi gatiin fe'umsaa idil-addunyaa dabaluun isaa qabeenya isaanii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumaa jira. Walitti bu'iinsa naannawa biyyoota giddu galeessa bahaa irraa kan ka'e baasii geejjibaa fi fe'umsaa dabaluun isaa, qonnaan beeytittiin gabaa Awurooppaa irratti dorgomtuu ta'ee itti fufuuf qormaata guddaa keessa galteetti.

title: The Hotel That Housed the OAU Meets the Wrecking Ball
english: Ethiopia Hotel, a historic landmark in Addis Ababa known for hosting the 1963 OAU founding, is currently being demolished to make way for a modern tower. The owner, BK Group, plans to replace the six-decade-old structure with a larger, contemporary complex. While this redevelopment marks a significant change for the city, it has also sparked concerns regarding the preservation of historical landmarks in the capital.
amharic: የአፍሪካ አንድነት ድርጅትን የመመስረቻ ስብሰባን በማስተናገድ የሚታወቀውና በአዲስ አበባ ታሪካዊ ምልክት የሆነው ኢትዮጵያ ሆቴል፣ በአዲስ ዘመናዊ ሕንፃ ለመተካት እየፈረሰ ነው። የሆቴሉ ባለቤት የሆነው ቢኬ ግሩፕ፣ ከስድስት አስርት ዓመታት በላይ አገልግሎት የሰጠውን የድሮ ሕንፃ በማፍረስ ዘመናዊ ግንባታ ለማካሄድ እቅድ አውጥቷል። ሆኖም ይህ የከተማዋን ገጽታ የሚቀይር ግንባታ፣ የታሪካዊ ቅርሶች ጥበቃን በተመለከተ በከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Hoteelli Itoophiyaa kan durii, kan hundeeffama gamtaa Afrikaa (OAU) bara 1963 keessummeessuun beekamu, bakka isaa gamoo ammayyaa ijaaruuf diigamaa jira. Abbaan qabeenyaa isaa, gareen BK, gamoolee waggaa ja’atamii oliif tajaajila kennan diigee bakka isaanii bakka ammayyaa ijaaruuf karoorfateera. Diigamni kun, guddina magaalaa Finfinnee keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fiduus, dhimmichi eegumsa seenaa fi bakkeewwan seena qabeeyyii irratti gaaffii uumee jira.

title: Tax on Alcohol, Tobacco Worked. Study Finds That May Be the Problem
english: Ethiopia's excise tax on alcohol and tobacco has successfully increased government revenue and reduced legal sales, but it is causing unintended consequences. Many consumers are avoiding higher prices by switching to unregulated homemade alcohol and illicit cigarettes. Researchers warn that this shift not only undermines the tax's effectiveness but also moves consumption into markets that bypass safety regulations and government oversight.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ በአልኮል እና በሲጋራ ላይ የተጣለው የኤክሳይስ ታክስ የመንግስትን ገቢ በመጨመር ህጋዊ ሽያጮችን ለመቀነስ ቢሳካም ያልታሰበ ችግር ፈጥሯል። ብዙ ሸማቾች የዋጋ ጭማሪውን በመሸሽ ወደ ቤት ውስጥ ወደሚጠመቁ መጠጦች እና ህገ-ወጥ ሲጋራዎች እያመሩ ይገኛሉ። ተመራማሪዎች ይህ ሁኔታ የታክሱ ትርፍ እየቀነሰ መምጣቱን ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ህገ-ወጥ የገበያ እንቅስቃሴዎች እንዲስፋፉ እና የጤና ቁጥጥር እንዲዳከም እያደረገ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gibirri alkoolii fi tamboo irratti biyya keenyatti godhame galii mootummaa dabaluu fi gurgurtaa seera qabeessa hir'isuu irratti milkaa'us, rakkoo biraa fiduu danda'eera. Maamiltoonni hedduun gatii dabale kana baqachuudhaan gara dhugaatii mana keessatti qophaa'uu fi tamboo seeraan alatti gurguramutti jijjiiramaa jiru. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, jijjiiramni kun bu'aa gibirichi qabu xiqqeessuu qofa osoo hin taane, gabaa seeraan alaa babal'isuu fi to'annoo fayyaa dadhabsiisuu danda'a.

title: Bus Firms Spend Hundreds of Millions, Hit Bank, Tariff, Charging Walls
english: Three major inter-city transport companies have invested 450 million Birr to upgrade their fleets to comply with new government regulations. However, these businesses now face serious financial risks due to high taxes, difficult bank lending conditions, and a lack of necessary infrastructure like charging stations. The operators argue that inconsistent government policies and the removal of previously agreed-upon incentives are threatening their massive investments.
amharic: ሶስት ዋና ዋና የከተማ አቋራጭ የትራንስፖርት ድርጅቶች የመንግስትን አዲስ መመሪያ ለማክበር 450 ሚሊዮን ብር ወጪ በማድረግ አዳዲስ አውቶቡሶችን ገዝተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ድርጅቶቹ በከፍተኛ ታክስ፣ በብድር እጥረት እና እንደ ኃይል መሙያ ጣቢያ ባሉ መሰረተ ልማቶች አለመሟላት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ አደጋ ውስጥ መውደቃቸውን ገልጸዋል። በተደጋጋሚ የሚቀያየሩ የመንግስት ፖሊሲዎች እና ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ ጥቅማጥቅሞች መቅረታቸው ኢንቨስትመንታቸውን አደጋ ላይ እንደጣለባቸው ቅሬታቸውን ያቀርባሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbileen geejjiba magaalaota gidduu hojjetan sadan, qajeelfama mootummaan haaraa baase kabajuuf jecha gabaa birrii miiliyoona 450 baasanii konkolaattota haaraa bitaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, gibira ol'aanaa, hanqina liqii baankii fi hanqina bu'uuraalee misoomaa akka buufata chaarjii jiran irraa kan ka'e, dhaabbileen kun rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa seenaniiru. Abbootiin qabeenyaa kun, jijjiirama siyaasaa mootummaa fi haquma faayidaa duraan walii galameefiin invastimantiin isaanii balaaf saaxilamuu isaatiif komii dhiyeeffataa jiru.

title: More troops to be sent to West Bank village besieged by Israeli settlers
english: The Israeli military is deploying more soldiers to a West Bank village after failing to remove settlers who have besieged two Palestinian families for several days. These families have been trapped without power, water, or sufficient food, sparking significant international concern. U.S. officials have condemned the violence and pressured Israel to intervene as the military struggles to control settler actions in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዌስት ባንክ መንደር ለብዙ ቀናት ሁለት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን ከበው የያዙ ሰፋሪዎችን ማስወጣት ባለመቻላቸው ተጨማሪ ወታደሮችን ለመላክ ተገደዋል። ቤተሰቦቹ ያለ ኤሌክትሪክ፣ ውሃ እና ምግብ በመታሰራቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ትኩረትን ስቧል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ጥቃት በማውገዝ እስራኤል ፈጣን እርምጃ እንድትወስድ ግፊት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤልም በሰፋሪዎች ላይ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ እየተቸገረች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el maatiiwwan Falasxiin lama guyyoota hedduuf naannawa Qusraa keessatti marfaman gadhiisiisuu waan dadhabeef, waraana dabalataa gara naannichaatti ergaa jira. Maatiiwwan kunneen bishaan, ibsaa fi nyaata malee hidhamanii turuun isaanii yaaddoo addunyaa kaasee jira. Aangottonni Ameerikaa gocha kana balaaleeffachuun Israa'el tarkaanfii akka fudhattu gaafataniiru, mootummaan Israa'el garuu gocha raawwattoota kana to'achuuf rakkachaa jira.

title: Indian actor's video with endangered gibbon sparks investigation
english: Indian actor Vikram is facing an official investigation after posting a video on social media showing him interacting with an endangered lar gibbon. Wildlife authorities are looking into how the protected animal ended up in a private residence in Chennai and whether its possession follows legal requirements. While the actor has not yet issued a statement, officials are currently verifying if the gibbon was obtained and imported in accordance with international wildlife trade regulations.
amharic: የህንድ ተዋናይ ቪክራም አደጋ ላይ ያለ ዝርያ የሆነውን 'ላር ጊቦን' የተባለ የዝንጀሮ ዓይነት አቅፎ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ከለቀቀ በኋላ ምርመራ እየተካሄደበት ነው። የዱር እንስሳት ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት እንስሳው በቼናይ በሚገኝ የግል መኖሪያ ቤት ውስጥ እንዴት እንደገባ እና አያያዙ ህጋዊ መሆኑን እያጣሩ ነው። ተዋናዩ እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምንም አይነት መግለጫ ያልሰጠ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት እንስሳው በአለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት በህጋዊ መንገድ መግባቱን ለማረጋገጥ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Aartistiin biyya Indiyaa Viikraam, fakkii sochiilee miidiyaa irratti bineensa gosa 'laar gibboon' jedhamu kan baduuf jedhu waliin taphachaa jiru erga gadhiisee booda qorannoon irra gaggeeffamaa jira. Qondaaltonni eegumsa bineensotaa, bineensi kun akkamitti manatti akka dhufeefi qabiinsi isaa seera qabeessa ta'uu isaa qulqulleeffachaa jiru. Aartistichi hanga ammaatti ibsa kan hin kennine yoo ta'u, qondaaltonni bineensi kun seera addunyaa kabajuun gara biyyattii galee jiraachuu isaa mirkaneeffachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: How to stay safe during an earthquake: A visual guide
english: To stay safe during an earthquake, it is essential to prepare your home by securing heavy furniture and creating an emergency kit with basic supplies like water, food, and medicine. When shaking occurs, remain indoors and avoid running outside to protect yourself from falling debris. After the earthquake stops, check for injuries and remain alert for potential hazards like gas leaks or aftershocks.
amharic: የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በሚከሰትበት ጊዜ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅ ከባድ የቤት እቃዎችን ማሰር እና እንደ ውሃ፣ ምግብ እና መድሃኒት ያሉ አስፈላጊ ቁሳቁሶችን የያዘ የአደጋ ጊዜ ቦርሳ ማዘጋጀት በጣም አስፈላጊ ነው። መንቀጥቀጡ ሲጀምር ከህንጻ ውጭ ከመሮጥ ይልቅ በቤት ውስጥ መቆየት ከሚወድቁ ነገሮች ይከላከላል። መንቀጥቀጡ ካቆመ በኋላ በሰውነትዎ ላይ ጉዳት መኖሩን ያረጋግጡ እና እንደ ጋዝ ፍሳሽ ወይም ተከታታይ መንቀጥቀጦች ያሉ አደጋዎች ስለሚኖሩ ጥንቃቄ ያድርጉ።
oromo: Gidiraa dachee yeroo raafamu of eeggannoo gochuuf, mana keessatti meeshaalee ulfaatoo hidhuu fi qophii hatattamaa kan akka bishaan, nyaata, fi qoricha walitti qabachun murteessadha. Yeroo raafamni jalqabu, ala fiigun balaa jiru waan dabaluuf, mana keessatti tasgabbaa'anii turuun irra caala. Erga raafamni dhaabatee booda, miidhaan jiraachu isaa of haa qorannu akkasumas balaa biraa kan akka xiriirri gaazii ykn raafama lammaffaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo haa kenninu.

title: Part of children’s hospital collapses in Colombia earthquake
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck Cali, Colombia, on Monday, causing a section of a local children's hospital to crumble. Security footage recorded the building's partial collapse during the tremor. The disaster has resulted in at least 265 confirmed fatalities, with many other individuals currently reported as missing.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በኮሎምቢያ ካሊ ከተማ በተከሰተ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የህፃናት ሆስፒታል ህንፃ ከፊል ክፍል ወድቋል። የደህንነት ካሜራዎች ህንፃው ሲፈርስ የተቀረጸውን ምስል ያሳዩ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን በደረሰው አደጋ ቢያንስ 265 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አሁንም በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የት እንዳሉ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Dilbata darbe biyya Kolombiyaa magaalaa Kaalii keessatti sochiin lafaa humni isaa 7.4 ta’e mudatee hospitaala daa’immanii tokkoo irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Kaameraawwan nageenyaa bakki hospitaalichaa tokko yeroo diigamu suuraa kaasaniru. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 265 olii darbeera, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa’amanis hanga ammaatti eessa akka jiran hin beekamu.

title: As temperatures soar, ‘exceptionally serious’ drought imperils UK farmers
english: Farmers in the United Kingdom are facing a severe agricultural crisis due to record-breaking heat and a lack of rainfall, which has left much of the country in a state of drought. The persistent dry conditions have caused crop yields to plummet and damaged soil health, forcing many producers to call for urgent government support. Experts warn that this recurring pattern of extreme weather is an increasingly serious threat to the nation's food production.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን እና የዝናብ እጥረት በመከሰቱ ገበሬዎች ከባድ የግብርና ቀውስ ውስጥ ገብተዋል። በሀገሪቱ በአብዛኛው አካባቢዎች የተከሰተው ድርቅ የምርት መጠን እንዲቀንስ እና የአፈር ሁኔታ እንዲበላሽ ስላደረገ፣ አምራቾች አስቸኳይ የመንግስት ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው እየጠየቁ ነው። ባለሙያዎች ይህ በተደጋጋሚ የሚከሰት ከፍተኛ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ለሀገሪቱ የምግብ ዋስትና ከፍተኛ ስጋት እየፈጠረ መሆኑን ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Biyyoota Gamtoomanii keessatti ho'i baay'ee fi roobni hir'achuu isaatiin walqabatee qotee bultoonni rakkoo cimaa keessa galaniiru. Hanqinni roobaa kun omisha gadi buusuu fi qulqullina biyyee irratti dhiibbaa waan geessiseef, qotee bultoonni mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa akka godhuuf gaafachaa jiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, haalli qilleensaa hamaa ta'e kun irra deddeebi'ee mudachuun isaa nageenya nyaataa biyyattii irratti balaa guddaa agarsiisa.

title: Three US states to hold executions on same day for first time since 2010
english: For the first time since 2010, three U.S. states—Tennessee, Alabama, and Oklahoma—are scheduled to carry out executions on the same day. Each inmate involved was convicted of murder, and these events occur despite a long-term national decline in public support for capital punishment. This rare triple execution highlights ongoing debates regarding the death penalty in the United States.
amharic: ከ2010 ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሶስት የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች ማለትም ቴነሲ፣ አላባማ እና ኦክላሆማ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ የሞት ፍርድ ለመፈጸም ተዘጋጅተዋል። በነዚህ ግዛቶች የሚፈጸሙት ግድያዎች ከባድ የወንጀል ድርጊት ፈጽመዋል በተባሉ እስረኞች ላይ የሚካሄዱ ናቸው። ምንም እንኳን በአሜሪካ የሞት ቅጣትን የሚደግፉ ሰዎች ቁጥር እየቀነሰ ቢመጣም፣ ይህ ክስተት በሀገሪቱ የሞት ቅጣት አሰጣጥ ላይ ትኩረትን ስቧል።
oromo: Akkuma bara 2010 booda yeroo jalqabaatiif, mootummoonni naannoo Ameerikaa sadan—Tennessee, Alabama fi Oklahoma—guyyaa tokkotti namoota adabbii du'aa itti murtaa'e ajjeesuuf qophaa'aniiru. Namoonni ajjeefaman kunneen hundi yakka ajjeechaa raawwachuun kan itti murtaa'aniidha. Ta'us, Ameerikaa keessatti namoonni adabbii du'aa morman dabalaa dhufuun beekamus, raawwiin kun seera adabbii du'aa irratti marii kaaseera.

title: Swiatek sinks Svitolina to set up Rybakina title clash in Toronto
english: Iga Swiatek defeated Elina Svitolina in the Toronto semifinals to secure a spot in the final. She will compete for the championship title against Elena Rybakina, who advanced after a comeback victory over Coco Gauff. This match marks Swiatek's first final appearance of the year as both players prepare for the upcoming US Open.
amharic: ኢጋ ስዋይቴክ በቶሮንቶ የግማሽ ፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ኤሊና ስቪቶሊናን በማሸነፍ ለፍጻሜ ደርሳለች። ለዋንጫው የምትፋለመው ደግሞ ኮኮ ጋፍን በመርታት ለፍጻሜ የደረሰችውን ኤሌና ሪባኪናን ነው። ይህ ውድድር ሁለቱም ተጫዋቾች ለሚመጣው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር እየተዘጋጁ ባለበት ወቅት፣ ስዋይቴክ በዚህ ዓመት ለፍጻሜ ስታልፍ የመጀመሪያዋ ነው።
oromo: Iga Swiatek tapha semi-fainalii Tooroontoo irratti Elina Svitolina mo'achuun gara fainaliitti darbiteetti. Igaan qophii tapha xumuraa irratti kan qunnamtu taphataan biyya Kaazaakistaan Elena Rybakina yoo taatu, isheenis Coco Gauff injifachuun xumuraaf ga'eetti. Taphoonni kun qophii dorgommii US Open irratti ta'uuf, Igaaf bara kanaaf yeroo jalqabaaf gara tapha xumuraa kan ishee geessise dha.

title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz is under its control
english: A senior Iranian official claims that Iran holds authority over the Strait of Hormuz. This statement serves as a direct rebuttal to US President Donald Trump, who recently asserted that America maintains full control of the vital shipping route. The conflicting declarations highlight ongoing geopolitical tensions regarding the management of this strategic waterway.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን የሆርሙዝ የባሕር መተላለፊያ በኢራን ቁጥጥር ሥር መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ አሜሪካ በዚሁ የባሕር መስመር ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት የገለጹትን የአሜሪካውን ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ንግግር የሚቃረን ነው። የሁለቱ ወገኖች ተቃራኒ አቋም በዚህ ስልታዊ የባሕር መስመር አስተዳደር ዙሪያ ያለውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran akka jedhanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz gama isaanitiin to’atamaa jira. Ibsi kun kan kenname, pirezidaantiin Amerika Donald Trump daandii galaana kanaa guutumaan guutuutti to’ataa akka jiran dubbachuu isaanii hordofee dha. Wal dhabdee ibsa kanaanis, nageenya daandii galaana kanaa irratti wal dhabdee siyaasaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: British maritime company engaged in salvage of stricken vessel off Omani coast
english: A British maritime security firm named Ambrey is currently managing the rescue of a tanker called Caroline Bezengi near the coast of Oman. Additional salvage ships have been dispatched to assist with the recovery efforts. The situation is being actively monitored to ensure the vessel is safely secured.
amharic: አምብሬ የተባለ የብሪታኒያ የባህር ደህንነት ኩባንያ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ ችግር ላይ የወደቀውን ካሮሊን ቤዘንጊ የተባለ መርከብ የማዳን ስራ እያከናወነ ይገኛል። ለዚህ ኦፕሬሽን ድጋፍ እንዲሰጡ ተጨማሪ የማዳኛ መርከቦች ወደ ስፍራው እየተጓዙ ነው። መርከቧን በሰላም ለማዳን የሚደረገው ጥረት ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni nageenya galaana beekamaa kan Biriiteen Ambrey jedhamu, doonii 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamtuu fi qarqara galaana Omaan irratti rakkoo keessa seente tasgabbessuuf hojjechaa jira. Hojii kana deggaruuf dooniiwwan gargaarsa biroo gara iddoo sanatti ergamaniiru. Hojiin doonii kana fayyisuuf taasifamu xiyyeeffannoon itti fufuun isaa ibsameera.

title: Morning update
english: Yemen's leadership has rejected a deal with the Houthis, seeking a peace that restores state control over weaponry. Meanwhile, Iraq has vowed to protect its sovereignty by banning the use of its territory for attacks against neighbors, and US officials have expressed doubt regarding reported Iranian threats against Donald Trump. Additionally, Iranian officials criticized Western nations over their support for Israel, while Hamas condemned a recent Israeli airstrike in Gaza for undermining ceasefire negotiations.
amharic: የየመን የአመራር ምክር ቤት ከሁቲዎች ጋር ስምምነት ለማድረግ ፈቃደኛ እንዳልሆነ አስታውቆ፣ በምትኩ የመንግስት የጦር መሳሪያ ቁጥጥር የሚያረጋግጥ ዘላቂ ሰላም እንደሚፈልግ ገልጿል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ኢራቅ የራሷን ሉዓላዊነት ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ግዛቷ ለጎረቤት ሀገራት ጥቃት እንዳይውል ከልክላለች። በተያያዘም የዩኤስ የስለላ ባለስልጣናት ስለ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የህይወት ስጋት የቀረበውን መረጃ አጠራጣሪ ብለውታል። ሀማስ በበኩሉ፣ በእስራኤል የተፈጸመው የአየር ድብደባ የተኩስ አቁም ንግግሮችን እንደሚያደናቅፍ በመግለጽ ኮንኗል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yaman humnoota Huutii waliin walii galtee uumuu diduun, nagaa waaraa kan biyyattii irratti humna waraanaa tokko qofa taasisu barbaaduu isaa ibseera. Iiraaq gama isheetin, qilleensa fi lafa ishee kanneen biroo irratti waraana gaggeessuuf itti fayyadamuu akka hin danda'amne akeekkachiifteetti. Gareen ogeeyyii iccitii Ameerikaa doorsisa Iiraan irraa Donald Trump irratti qajeele jedhamee dubbatame kan amanamu miti jedhaniiru. Gama biraatiin, gareen Haamaas haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el gaaza irratti raawwatte, yaalii nagaa buusuu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'uu isaa ibsee balaaleffateera.

title: Pakistan says Israel's refusal to withdraw forces from Gaza 'serious setback' to peace plan
english: Pakistan has formally criticized Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for rejecting the creation of a Palestinian state and refusing to pull troops out of Gaza. The Pakistani Foreign Ministry emphasized that Palestinian statehood is supported by international law and UN mandates, regardless of Israel's current stance. Officials in Islamabad warned that Israel’s decision to maintain a military presence in Gaza undermines previously agreed-upon peace commitments.
amharic: ፓኪስታን የፍልስጤም መንግሥት እንዲመሰረት አለመቀበሉን እና ከጋዛ ወታደሮቹን ለማስወጣት ፈቃደኛ አለመሆኑን በመቃወም የእስራኤሉን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ አውግዛለች። የፓኪስታን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው፣ የእስራኤል አቋም ምንም ይሁን ምን የፍልስጤም መንግሥትነት በዓለም አቀፍ ሕግ እና በተባበሩት መንግሥታት ውሳኔዎች የተረጋገጠ ነው። ኢስላማባድ አክላም እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን ከጋዛ ላለማስወጣት የወሰደችው ውሳኔ ቀደም ሲል የገቡትን የሰላም ስምምነቶች የሚጥስ እና ለሰላም ሂደት ትልቅ እንቅፋት መሆኑን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Paakistaan ministira muummee Israa'el Binyamiin Neetaanyaahuu mootummaa Falasxiin uumuuf diduu fi waraana ishee gaazaatii baasuu diduu ishee cimsitee balaaleffatteetti. Ministeerri dhimmi alaa Paakistaan akka jedhutti, mootummaan Falasxiin seera idil-addunyaa fi murtee gamtaa mootummoota gamtoomaniin kan deggerame ta'uu isaa ibseera. Bulchiinsi Islaamaabaad akka ibsetti, Israa'el gaazaa keessaa waraana ishee baasuu diduun ishee walii galtee nagaa duraan irra ga'ame kan cabsuu fi carraaqqii nagaa irratti gufuu guddaa akka ta'e akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Israeli troops set on fire, bombed homes in south Lebanon
english: Early on Thursday, Israeli military forces conducted bombings and burned residential houses in southern Lebanese towns, including Majdal Zoun and Mansouri. These military actions have persisted even as discussions regarding a potential peace deal remain ongoing. The attacks continue to impact civilian infrastructure in the region despite international efforts to reach a ceasefire.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በለባኖን ደቡባዊ ክፍሎች በሚገኙ ማጅዳል ዞን እና ማንሱሪ ከተሞች የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በቦምብ ድብደባ የቤት ንብረቶችን አውድመዋል እንዲሁም አቃጥለዋል። ምንም እንኳን የሰላም ንግግሮች እየተደረጉ ቢሆንም የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች ግን አሁንም እንደቀጠሉ ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ የሚገኙ ሲቪል የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa ganama, waraanni Israa'el magaalonni kibba Libaanoos kanneen akka Majdal Zoon fi Mansuurii keessatti haleellaa boombii gaggeessuun manneen jiraattotaa gubaniiru. Haasaawwan nagaa ta’aa jiranis, waraanni Israa'el haleellaa isaa itti fufuu isaa gabaasni ni mul'isa. Haleellaan kun qabeenyaa fi jireenya nagaa naannichaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: The US is now using the ‘terrorist’ label to interfere in Brazil’s election
english: The United States recently labeled Brazil's two largest criminal groups, the PCC and CV, as terrorist organizations. Critics argue this move is politically motivated rather than based on security needs, as these groups primarily seek criminal profit rather than political change. By applying this label, the US is accused of interfering in Brazilian internal politics and empowering the country’s far-right factions.
amharic: አሜሪካ በብራዚል ትልቁን ወንጀለኛ ቡድኖች የሆኑትን ፒሲሲ እና ሲቪን እንደ አሸባሪ ድርጅቶች ሰይማለች። ተቺዎች እንደሚሉት ይህ ውሳኔ የፀጥታ ጉዳይን ከመፍታት ይልቅ የብራዚልን የውስጥ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ለመግባት እና ለቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲከኞች ድጋፍ ለመስጠት የታለመ ነው። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በዋናነት ለወንጀል ትርፍ እንጂ ለፖለቲካዊ ለውጥ የሚሰሩ ስላልሆኑ፣ የአሜሪካ ድርጊት አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Ameerikaan gareewwan yakka gurguddoo biyyattii lamanii, PCC fi CV, jechuun moggaasuun 'shororkeessitoota' jedhee labsiteetti. Qeeqtonni akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun nageenya eeguurra darbee, dhimma keessoo biyyaa fi siyaasaa Biraazil keessa gadi seenuuf kan karoorfamee fi garee mirga-olaantummaa (far-right) deggeruuf kan gargaaru dha. Gareewwan kun kan hundeeffaman bu'aa yakkaatiif malee kaayyoo siyaasaatiif waan hin taaneef, labsiin kun faayidaa siyaasaa qofaaf kan taasifame jedhamee qeeqama.

title: Will the Houthis shut down Saudi Arabian shipping?
english: There are growing international concerns regarding the potential for renewed conflict in Yemen, which could threaten maritime security in the region. Analysts are questioning whether Houthi forces might attempt to disrupt Saudi Arabian shipping lanes as regional tensions escalate. This situation highlights the ongoing instability in the Middle East and the complex security challenges facing major global trade routes.
amharic: በየመን ሊቀሰቀስ ስለሚችለው አዲስ ግጭት እና ይህ ሁኔታ በአካባቢው የባህር ትራንስፖርት ላይ ሊያሳድር ስለሚችለው ተጽዕኖ አለም አቀፍ ስጋቶች እያደጉ ነው። እየጨመረ በመጣው የክልሉ ውጥረት ሳቢያ፣ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሳውዲ አረቢያን የንግድ መርከቦች ጉዞ ለማስተጓጎል ይሞክሩ ይሆን የሚለው ጥያቄ በባለሙያዎች እየተነሳ ነው። ይህ ሁኔታ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው አለመረጋጋት እና ለአለም አቀፍ የንግድ መስመሮች የተጋረጠውን የጸጥታ ስጋት ያሳያል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraanni deebi'ee ka'uu danda'uufi kun immoo nageenya karaa galaanaarratti dhiibbaa uumuu danda'u irratti yaaddoon idil-addunyaa dabalaa jira. Walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa hammaachaa waan jiruuf, gareen Huutii karaa dooniiwwan Sa'udii Arabaa ittiin darban cufuuf yaaluu danda'a jedhanii ogeeyyiin gaaffii kaasuutti jiru. Haalli kun nageenya dhabuu Baha Giddu-galeessaa fi balaa karaaleen daldala addunyaa qaban kan mul'isu dha.

title: Polls open in Zambia presidential election as economic reforms tested
english: Zambians are heading to the polls to decide if President Hakainde Hichilema deserves a second term as the country deals with significant economic struggles. While the current administration highlights its recent reforms and infrastructure projects, many voters remain concerned about the high cost of living. The election features 13 candidates, with former minister Brian Mundubile emerging as the main opposition figure challenging Hichilema’s leadership.
amharic: የዛምቢያ ህዝብ ፕሬዝዳንት ሃካይንድ ሂቺሌማ በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ ወይም ለውጥ እንዲያመጡ ድምጻቸውን እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ። የሂቺሌማ መንግስት ያደረገውን የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያ ለስኬት ቢጠቅስም፣ አብዛኛው ህዝብ ግን በኑሮ ውድነት መማረሩን ገልጿል። በምርጫው 13 እጩዎች የሚወዳደሩ ሲሆን፣ የቀድሞ ሚኒስትር ብሪያን ሙንዱቢሌ የፕሬዝዳንቱ ዋና ተፎካካሪ በመሆን እየተወዳደሩ ነው።
oromo: Ummanni Zambiyaa prezedantii Haakayinde Hichileema yeroo lammaffaaf muuduu fi dhiisuu isaanii irratti sagalee kennuuf gara mana filannootti ba'aa jiru. Mootummaan ammaa hojii misoomaa fi jijjiirama dinagdee hojjechaa jiraachuu ibsus, lammiileen baay'een gatiin jireenyaa olka'uu isaan yaaddessee jira. Filannoo kana irratti dorgomtoonni 13 kan hirmaatan yoo ta'u, ministeerri duraanii Biraayin Mundubilee mormituu ijoo ta'uun prezedanticha quunnameera.

title: Nearly 4 million Afghan children ‘acutely malnourished’
english: A new report from Save the Children reveals that nearly 4 million Afghan children under five are suffering from acute malnutrition. As aid continues to decline, children are losing access to the life-saving support they need to survive.
